title: Aseptic technique and culture handling
controls: Sterile technique, PPE, disinfect bench, no open flames near ethanol, autoclave waste
acceptance_criteria: No growth in blank; single colonies; no turbidity in uninoculated control
failure_triage: If contaminated: discard, disinfect, review technique, repeat with fresh media
data_record: Date, strain, medium, incubator, observer, photos

title: Media preparation and pH control
hazards: Heat-labile component degradation; precipitation; pH drift
controls: Separate sterilisation, calibrated pH meter, filter sterilise heat-labile stocks, label
acceptance_criteria: pH within 0.1 of target; clear solution; sterility blank negative
failure_triage: If precipitate: check order/stock; if pH drift: recalibrate and remake
data_record: Recipe, lot, pH before/after, sterilisation method

title: Protein expression and SDS-PAGE
controls: PPE, safe lid handling, acrylamide waste stream, gel apparatus check
acceptance_criteria: Band at expected MW; soluble/insoluble fraction; uninduced control; loading control
failure_triage: If no band: check induction/plasmid; if insoluble: lysis/temperature; repeat
data_record: Construct, induction OD, time, gel image, densitometry

title: Enzyme assay design
controls: Ice, fresh substrate, replicate wells, blank, standard curve
acceptance_criteria: Linear rate in initial-velocity window; R2 >0.99; CV <10%; blank <5%
failure_triage: If nonlinear: reduce enzyme/time; if no signal: check cofactor/assay pH
data_record: Enzyme lot, substrate batch, temperature, plate map

title: Kinetic parameter determination
hazards: Poor substrate range; evaporation; fitting bias
controls: At least 6 substrate concentrations; initial velocity; sealed plate; replicate
acceptance_criteria: Km and Vmax with CI; R2; residuals without trend; no substrate inhibition unmodelled
failure_triage: If fit poor: extend range; if inhibition: fit substrate-inhibition model
data_record: Raw rates, fit script, parameter table, diagnostics

title: Growth curve and optical density calibration
hazards: OD nonlinear at high density; blank drift; contamination
controls: Blank, dilution into linear range, duplicate, sterile handling
acceptance_criteria: R2 >0.99 over linear range; duplicate CV <5%; no blank growth
failure_triage: If nonlinear: dilute; if contamination: discard and repeat
data_record: Time, OD, dilution, blank, temperature

title: Shake flask physiology experiment
controls: Sterile flask, baffle/volume check, timed sampling, replicate
acceptance_criteria: Growth and pH trajectory consistent; carbon balance closure stated; no contamination
failure_triage: If no growth: check inoculum/media; if overflow: reduce volume/agitation
data_record: OD, pH, substrate/product, time, flask/medium lot

title: Dissolved oxygen measurement and kLa determination
controls: Calibrate DO before/after, temperature compensation, antifoam, replicate gassing
acceptance_criteria: kLa fit with R2 >0.95; replicate within 15%; probe drift stated
failure_triage: If drift: recalibrate; if foaming: add antifoam and rerun
data_record: kLa, DO trace, gassing rates, temperature, probe ID

title: HPLC for organic acids and sugars
controls: Calibration curve, blank, duplicate, recovery spike, guard column
acceptance_criteria: R2 >0.99; recovery 80-120%; carryover <1%; retention within window
failure_triage: If carryover: wash/blank; if recovery off: matrix-match standards
data_record: Column, method, standards, chromatograms, batch

title: Dry cell weight and biomass composition
controls: Pre-dried dish, desiccator, duplicate, ash step
acceptance_criteria: Stable dry weight; duplicate CV <3%; mass balance stated
failure_triage: If weight drifts: redry; if ash high: check media/salts
data_record: Dish ID, drying time/temp, weights, ash

title: Chemostat operation
controls: Steady state ≥3 residence volumes, frequent OD/pH, viable count, wall inspection
acceptance_criteria: OD, pH, substrate stable; viable count stable; dilution rate known
failure_triage: If washout: reduce D; if wall growth: clean/restart
data_record: D, OD, pH, counts, feed composition, time

title: Genomic DNA extraction and quality control
hazards: Shearing DNA; phenol/chloroform hazard; RNA contamination
controls: Gentle lysis, PPE, aqueous waste, RNase treatment
acceptance_criteria: A260/280 1.8-2.0; gel integrity; yield recorded
failure_triage: If sheared: gentle pipetting; if RNA: RNase; repeat
data_record: Extraction kit/lot, yield, ratios, gel

title: PCR and gel electrophoresis
controls: No-template control, positive control, filter tips, safe gel handling
acceptance_criteria: Band at expected size; no-template negative; positive control works
failure_triage: If no band: check primers/template; if extra bands: annealing gradient
data_record: Primers, template, cycling, gel image

title: Plasmid preparation and restriction analysis
hazards: Residual genomic DNA; incomplete digest; ethidium waste
controls: Alkaline lysis, RNase, diagnostic digest, safe stain waste
acceptance_criteria: Expected digest pattern; no smear; concentration/ratio
failure_triage: If wrong pattern: check digest/clone; if smear: nuclease/gentle prep
data_record: Plasmid ID, digest enzymes, gel, concentration

title: Transformation and competent cell preparation
controls: Positive control plasmid, negative no-DNA, correct antibiotic, ice
acceptance_criteria: CFU/µg above threshold; no colonies on no-DNA; correct phenotype
failure_triage: If zero: check competence/antibiotic; if lawn: reduce DNA/selection
data_record: Strain, plasmid, CFU, antibiotic lot, recovery time

title: Metabolite sampling and quenching
hazards: Quench speed; leakage; degradation; cold hazard
controls: Cold quench, timed sampling, internal standard, PPE
acceptance_criteria: Recovery >80%; no degradation in quench control; isotope standard recoveries
failure_triage: If recovery low: shorten sampling/validate quench; if degradation: colder/faster
data_record: Time, volume, quench, internal standard, LC-MS run

title: Labelling experiment execution
controls: Labeled/unlabeled controls, time course, wash, mass balance
acceptance_criteria: Label enrichment plateau; mass balance; no carryover
failure_triage: If no plateau: extend time; if carryover: wash/blank
data_record: Tracer lot, timepoints, enrichment, analytical run

title: Enzyme activity in cell-free extract
controls: Protease inhibitor, lysis control, blank, protein assay
acceptance_criteria: Activity linear with extract; blank low; protein-normalised rate
failure_triage: If low: check lysis; if high background: dialyse/blank
data_record: Extract batch, protein, substrate, rate, blank

title: Gibson and Golden Gate assembly
controls: No-insert control, junction PCR/sequencing, filter tips
acceptance_criteria: Correct junction sequence; colony PCR; no-insert control low
failure_triage: If no colonies: check assembly; if wrong junction: redesign overhang
data_record: Fragments, overhangs, colony PCR, sequence

title: Promoter and RBS library construction and screening
hazards: Library bias; insufficient coverage; selection escape
controls: Coverage calculation, independent colonies, positive/negative controls
acceptance_criteria: Library size ≥100x coverage; control strains behave; screen CV
failure_triage: If coverage low: increase transformations; if bias: redesign RBS
data_record: Library design, colony count, screening data

title: Lambda-Red recombineering and CRISPR editing
controls: Guide design, no-guide control, Sanger/amplicon, containment
acceptance_criteria: Edit confirmed by sequencing; no-guide control unedited; off-target panel
failure_triage: If no edit: check guide/donor; if off-target: redesign/validate
data_record: Guides, donors, PCR, sequences, phenotype

title: Directed evolution round
hazards: False positives; library loss; selection drift
controls: Retest hits, independent replicates, negative control, storage
acceptance_criteria: Enrichment reproducible; hit retest; no activity in negative
failure_triage: If no enrichment: check selection; if false positives: retest
data_record: Library, rounds, selection, retest data

title: Bioreactor batch fermentation
controls: Pressure relief, antifoam, sterile sampling, gas analysis
acceptance_criteria: Carbon/redox balance closure 90-110%; no contamination; steady profile
failure_triage: If balance off: check off-gas/feed; if contamination: sterilise/restart
data_record: Vessel, medium, feed, OD, products, off-gas

title: Fed-batch with exponential feeding
controls: Feed calibration, level sensor, DO control, backup pump
acceptance_criteria: No overflow; target growth; balance closure; DO above critical
failure_triage: If overflow: stop feed/check probe; if DO low: adjust feed/agitation
data_record: Feed profile, pump cal, OD, DO, products

title: Off-gas analysis and the carbon balance
controls: Calibrate gases, dry sample, leak test, replicate
acceptance_criteria: Carbon recovery 90-110%; no drift; leak test passes
failure_triage: If recovery off: leak/calibration; if drift: recalibrate
data_record: Gas analyzer, calibration, flow, recovery

title: Flow cytometry and single-cell analysis
controls: PPE, compensation beads, FMO controls, fixed voltages
acceptance_criteria: FMO gates; CV <5%; compensation check
failure_triage: If compensation off: rerun beads; if drift: recalibrate
data_record: Instrument, voltages, beads, gating strategy

title: Scale-down two-compartment experiment
controls: Two-compartment calibration, residence time match, sterile setup
acceptance_criteria: Mixing/residence times match target; DO gradient reproducible
failure_triage: If mismatch: adjust flows; if contamination: restart
data_record: Compartment volumes, flows, DO, residence time

title: Downstream unit operations at bench scale
controls: Mass balance, solvent waste, pressure relief, replicate
acceptance_criteria: Step yields and purity meet target; overall mass balance
failure_triage: If yield low: check phase/emulsion; if purity low: repeat step
data_record: Unit op, volumes, yields, purity, mass balance

title: Analytical method validation
hazards: Standard degradation; matrix effect; false validation
controls: Fresh standards, matrix blank, independent replicates, pre-defined criteria
acceptance_criteria: Accuracy 80-120%; precision CV <15%; LOD/LOQ stated; carryover
failure_triage: If accuracy fails: check standard/matrix; if precision fails: increase replicates
data_record: Analyte, matrix, standards, runs, acceptance table

title: Laboratory notebook and data management standard
hazards: Data loss; version confusion; missing metadata
controls: Version control, checksums, backup, metadata schema
acceptance_criteria: Fresh clone reproduces; checksums match; metadata complete
failure_triage: If missing: restore backup; if mismatch: re-export
data_record: Repo commit, checksums, README, data dictionary
